text: I feel a sense of intellectual curiosity walking through this modern space. The large windows and visible presentation suggest a setting of learning or innovation. As I enter the next room, the colorful R+D wall draws me in—its bold design and illuminating signs about research and development evoke feelings of creativity and possibility. There is excitement in the air, a subtle hum of ideas being incubated. I feel both like an observer and a participant in the ongoing dance of human ingenuity.
